reuse.deja_query: E132 live descriptor allocation signature batch lease vkAllocateDescriptorSets prefetch pool
local_contracts: E121 authoritative descriptor-pool reset and child retirement
E131 locally claimed typed descriptor leases
reuse.external_authority: Vulkan vkAllocateDescriptorSets specifies that a failed multi-set allocation destroys any sets allocated by that call and returns all output handles as VK_NULL_HANDLE: https://registry.khronos.org/vulkan/specs/latest-ratified/pdf/vkspec.pdf

implementation.batch_backoff: For a live miss, Bionic tries the largest bounded repetition of the exact pool/layout signature, then halves the repetition count after OUT_OF_POOL_MEMORY or FRAGMENTED_POOL until a useful batch fits; otherwise it performs the exact request.

correctness.native_authority: Every published ID comes from a successful real Bionic vkAllocateDescriptorSets call; the requested prefix is returned to that call and only the extras are published.
correctness.journal_order: The glibc client bypasses local lease claim whenever descriptor-journal bytes or records are pending, forcing the ordered worker transaction to replay updates before allocation.
correctness.reset: A successful pool reset disables every bank for that pool and clears capacity fallback state before any optional refill.
correctness.destroy: Pool destruction disables and forgets every matching signature bank.
correctness.capacity: Retry after OUT_OF_POOL_MEMORY or FRAGMENTED_POOL is safe because Vulkan destroys all partial sets from the failed multi-set call. Other native errors are returned unchanged.
correctness.bounded_caveat: Published extras consume real pool capacity until claimed or until reset/destroy. A bank publication failure disables further batching for that signature until reset; no handle is fabricated.

validation.first_signature: One live ring miss allocates sixteen real sets and the next fifteen identical calls are local typed lease hits with zero additional ring calls.
validation.second_signature: A distinct layout signature in the same pool incurs one live ring miss, then its next identical call is a local hit while the first bank remains valid.
validation.fallback: The fake native pool rejects oversized batches with OUT_OF_POOL_MEMORY; bounded backoff reaches a fitting batch or the exact one-set call, and the profile records the fallback.
validation.reset_destroy: The cross-process contract verifies reset invalidates every prior proxy and destroy retires the pool's banks.

next_gate: Deploy the exact client/service pair and rerun the native-resolution Low Tomb Raider benchmark. Compare lease hit rate, ring calls per present, ANR behavior, and game-authored FPS against E130 and E131.
